svc-metrics: :rotating_light: ALERT: /v1/stream p99 latency > 3.2s over 5m window (SLO p99=1.5s). Traffic concentrated in us-west-2. Error rate not elevated, but streaming tail stalls seen (clients reporting long gaps between tokens). Rolling sample request ids available.

oncall-bot: Incident created 2755551234. Priority: P1 (latency SLO breach). Assigned to: @Mike SRE. Please confirm impact and start live mitigation.

Mike SRE: I'm on it. Looking at traces now. Any recent infra or config changes? Also adding @Anya for cache context.

Anya: FWIW, prefix-cache miss rate jumped from ~6% -> ~94% around 2755550100. That coincides with a prefix-hash rollout (v2) we pushed earlier today to improve bucket distribution. I see almost zero prefix hits on the new hosts — keys don't seem to map to expected buckets.

Jordan (Platform): Confirmed — we rolled `prefix-hash:v2` to dedicated pool at 2755550087. The change added salting + truncated sha256 -> 64-bit. Intended to reduce collisions. Rollout was gradual (50% at first). No canary flags flipped.

Mike SRE: If prefix hits are gone, that explains the streaming stalls — every request misses cache and hits cold path, causing tail token recomputation. Need quick mitigation: can we flip back to v1 on the serving tier or enable compatibility shim?

Lex (DevEx): Suggested mitigation: enable `LEGACY_PREFIX_HASH=true` on affected service group to restore old mapping. We can also push a hotfix to shim that translates v2 keys back to v1 mapping for a warmup window.

Raj Ops: Rolling back config on production GPU pools will cause some connection churn but is acceptable vs continuing SLO breach. We should target the dedicated pool only (avoid touching other regions). I'll prepare the rollback play.

Emma CS: Customers alerted: two enterprise customers reported streaming stalls for ~3-7m each. They've opened support tickets referencing high p99 and stuck streams. CS is prepping outreach and impact notes. We should include estimated affected user counts.

Mike SRE: Action plan (short):
1) Apply `LEGACY_PREFIX_HASH=true` to dedicated-serving group (us-west-2) to restore old key mapping.
2) Trigger gentle cache warmup: prefetch top 1000 prefixes for largest customers.
3) If (1) can't be applied fast, route heavy customers to fallback model variant in us-east-1.
4) Post-rollback, verify p95/p99 and streaming token continuity.

Mike SRE: Exec commands — rollback shim (run from infra jump):
```
# set env var on the serving deployment
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/serving-dedicated LEGACY_PREFIX_HASH=true --context=prod-us-west-2
# restart pods gradually
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/serving-dedicated --context=prod-us-west-2
```

Jordan (Platform): I'm staging the env var change now. Will use `maxUnavailable=1` to reduce churn. Also preparing a targeted canary for 2 pods before full rollout.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: rollback-prefixhash-2755553000 by Jordan. Canary start -> 2755553120.

deploy-bot: Canary pass. Rolling out env var to remaining pods in serving-dedicated (us-west-2). Rollout started 2755553200, in-progress.

svc-metrics: p99 trending down: 3.2s -> 1.4s over next 8m after canary began. p95 stable ~220ms. Streaming stalls count down by ~85%. Cache hit rate rising back to ~72% for prefix-cache in affected pool.

Mike SRE: Great. Continuing observation. Please hold off on routing changes unless we see a regression during rollout.

Emma CS: Notifying affected customers that we have rolled back a recent prefix-hash change and are seeing improvement. Will share timeframe and mitigation steps. Asking if we have a formal RCA ETA.

Anya: Need to schedule postmortem. Root cause looks like subtle encoding change in the hashing function when we switched from v1 to v2 (salting introduced + different truncation edge-case for very short prefixes). Tests missed it because unit tests used normalized keys.

Lex (DevEx): Follow-ups: Update rollout playbook to include a post-deploy smoke that verifies prefix hit distribution on a synthetic keyset. Also add a metric alert on prefix-hit-rate delta > 15% after any prefix-hash change.

Mike SRE: Handing off to follow-up squad for full RCA + perf regression tests. I'm on-call for another 20m then handing to @Raj Ops for overnight watch. Writing an incident summary and linking tickets.

Raj Ops: Accepted handoff. Will keep watch on p99 and streaming stall count. Please add runbook actions to incident document.

Mike SRE: Closing live mitigation. Final metrics before handoff: p99=1.2s, p95=210ms, prefix-cache hit=75% in affected pool. Logging all commands and deploy IDs in the incident doc.

oncall-bot: Handoff noted. Next on-call: Raj Ops. Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring ongoing, impact noted to CS. Please file postmortem within 72 hours and tag `postmortem/latency-prefix-hash`.

Emma CS: Added customer impact notes and preliminary timeline to ticket. I'll follow-up once postmortem is available so CS can craft external comms.

Mike SRE: Thanks everyone. Postmortem checklist: scope affected customers, root cause (v2 salting/truncation mismatch), test gaps, roll-forward plan (fix hashing code + add compatibility shim), rollout guardrails (smoke tests + prefix-hit delta alert), owner's assigned.

Anya: I'll own the fix and the compatibility tests. ETA 48h for patch + canary. Will coordinate with DevEx for the new smoke tests.

Lex (DevEx): I'll update the runbook and add the automatic prefix-hit delta alert. Also will add a note to the release checklist to run the synthetic mapping test before prefix-hash changes.

deploy-bot: Incident 2755551234 mitigation log saved. Actions: rollback-prefixhash-2755553000 (canary pass).

Mike SRE: Marking thread for postmortem write-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
